4477-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4477-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

64-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

802-4217.easyPrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield.
802-4217.notablePrerequisites: You control two lands that collectively tap for enough to cast Lutri.
802-4217.description:
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting any creature.
With the original Snap on the stack, cast Lutri.
Resolve the Lutri ETB, causing you to create a copy of Snap and change its target to Lutri.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Lutri to your hand and untapping two lands that produce enough to recast it.
Repeat from step 2.
802-4217.notes: If your chosen lands tap for enough mana, this combo results in infinite mana.

789-4279-5931--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-5931--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1879-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2438-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1818-2173-5010-6495.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1818-2173-5010-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3234-3293-4247-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4247-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4247-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

348-1152-2393-4867-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2393-4867-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Sifter of Skulls triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

728-2577-3755.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

457-1409-3761-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Crusher by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Crusher leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Crusher
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Crusher when it left the battlefield.
When the Mutagens enter, Arcbound Crsuher triggers that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each trigger.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Crusher and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-3761-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7338.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

628-4050-7219.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

967-1308-3809-5686-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

586-2921-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

104-2034-3490-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-6720.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

671-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Viscera Seer enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4067-6625-6629.description:
Activate Rune-Sealed Wall by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rune-Sealed Wall
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-5686.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-5686.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2452-3249-5670-6273--56.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-6273--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

997-1789-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
997-1789-4875-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-560-4550-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-560-4550-4616.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Blasting Station trigger, sacrificing the Soldier token instead.
Repeat.

511-817-851-3334-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-3967-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3967-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie.
Repeat.

1244-2908-4231-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
1244-2908-4231-5542.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Cast the other creature by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Pinnacle Monk

2104-2665-5913.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3490-3910-4017-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
1270-3490-3910-4017-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1061-1379-4331-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-1379-4331-5295.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Timestream Navigator.
When the Timestream Navigators enter the battlefield, if you do not have the city's blessing, they trigger, giving you the city's blessing.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

1636-2532-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You have at least one card in hand.
1636-2532-4050.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
The copy enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the copy, adding {R}.
The creature dies, triggering itself, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2104-3554-4079.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Scheming Symmetry and Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Scheming Symmetry by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.

65-717-2628-4652-4686.description:
Activate Polluted Mire's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Polluted Mire, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Polluted Mire trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Polluted Mire and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
